sin.name: agent-words-without-key
sin.description: A listener stores the agent's words without an idempotency key, so whether they are stored already can only be told by their text, and an edit of the message stores them again.
sin.rule: Store words read from a transcript with idempotency=VoiceKey.create(kind, session, text) and check messages.sent_with(key) first, as the worker and subagent chats do; never decide by comparing texts.
